draft.subject: Your SSO question — and a first project for Quartz Labs
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for raising SSO — your ticket is still open on our side and I'm following up on it. One thing I can share now: SSO is available on the Team plan, so on Starter it isn't switched on yet.

In the meantime, it's worth getting Quartz Labs' first project started, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'll happily walk through that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Priya
